items.title: Altria Group (MO) Weighs All Cash Tobacco Deal That Could Reshape Competition

Management is examining options to acquire either the entire Imperial Brands business or select assets instead of a full purchase. Altria has publicly acknowledged that talks are preliminary, with no binding agreement or transaction terms announced as of 27 November 2026.
